market_signal_card.callout: In one line: RFID does not lack people who test tags; it lacks field experts who understand applications, deploy systems, and optimize performance.
facts: The signals above are compiled from public job-platform information: unofficial, not real-time, refreshed quarterly (source, 2026-08).
These signals are directional references, not a basis for employment decisions.
For real-time data, refer to job platforms and official releases.
market_signal_card.intro: Hiring and industry signals show RFID demand concentrating on solution design + industry settings + data analysis.
signals: Retail and logistics RFID project volume continues rising
Job postings commonly prefer field deployment experience
Demand rises for solution design and project management roles
AI data-analysis capabilities become an advantage

market_signal_card.intro: 从招聘与行业信号看，RFID 人才的需求在向「方案设计 + 行业场景 + 数据分析」集中。
signals: 零售与物流 RFID 项目持续上量
招聘普遍要求「有现场部署经验优先」
方案设计与项目管理岗位需求上升
AI 数据分析能力成为加分项
